About

About Sola Hair Salon

Sola Hair Salon is an independent, editorially run resource covering the salon-studio model, hair services, hairstyles, hair care and salon pricing. Our goal is to give people clear, practical information before they book an appointment — nothing more.

Why This Site Exists

Searching for information about salon studios, salon pricing, or which haircut suits a particular face shape tends to turn up either official marketing pages or scattered, inconsistent forum advice. We started this site to sit in between those two extremes: independent enough to be candid about trade-offs and pricing realities, but organized and thorough enough to actually answer the question you came with. Every guide is written to answer one specific question completely, rather than padding out a topic with filler to rank for a keyword.

Independence

We are not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Sola Salon Studios. We reference the brand only to describe and inform, and we do not use Sola's logos, trademarks, or official branding. Nothing on this site should be read as an official statement from, or authorized directory of, Sola Salon Studios or any specific location or professional working within that model.

How We Approach the Free Tools

Our Salon Cost Calculator and Hair Length Calculator are built to be genuinely useful starting points, not lead-generation gimmicks. Both run entirely in your browser — no account, no email capture, no data sent to a server — and both are clearly labeled as estimates rather than exact quotes, because that's what they actually are. We'd rather a tool underpromise and be transparent about its limits than present a rough calculation as something more precise than it is.

Editorial Principles

  • Every article is written or reviewed by a human before publishing.
  • We don't publish scraped, spun, or copied content.
  • We don't fabricate statistics, reviews, or professional credentials.
  • Factual claims are checked against reliable sources where relevant.
  • We don't run ads that interrupt reading, and we don't design pages primarily around advertising.

What We're Still Building

This site is actively growing — new guides are added regularly, following the same questions people most often bring into a salon consultation. If you've read something here that felt incomplete, outdated, or just plain wrong, we genuinely want to hear about it and fix it, rather than let it sit.

What Makes a Guide "Original" Here

We take "original content" seriously in a specific, practical sense: every guide is written from scratch for this site, drawing on general, widely understood knowledge about hair services and salon business practices rather than being rewritten from any single competing source. Where a claim needs a factual anchor beyond general knowledge, we aim to check it rather than assume it's correct because it's commonly repeated elsewhere online.

A Note on Advertising

This site may eventually carry advertising to help sustain the work of researching and writing new guides, but ads are never allowed to determine what we recommend or how we describe a service, technique, or pricing range. If a page ever carries a sponsored placement, it will be clearly labeled as such — nothing here is designed to look like independent advice while secretly being paid promotion.

Who's Behind This Site

Sola Hair Salon is run as a small, focused editorial project rather than a large publication with a masthead of contributors. Content is researched, written, and reviewed with an emphasis on accuracy and practical usefulness over volume — we would rather publish twenty genuinely thorough guides than two hundred thin ones. As the site grows, any named contributors will be introduced here with their actual background, and we won't claim credentials that aren't real.

Questions or corrections? Visit our Contact page.
